description:
Women’s Hair Conditioner for Dry & Frizzy Hair

Reduces Frizz: This Hair Conditioner for women is one of the best hair conditioners in India enriched with Silk protein, biotin & niacinamide that helps repair dry, frizzy, and unruly hair. This deep conditioner helps remove the frizz and dryness from the hair strands and makes them smooth and lustrous, making it an effective conditioner for dry hair.

Smoothens Hair Strands: Silk protein in this conditioner for frizzy hair helps smoothen hair strands and add shine and lustre to treat such frizziness.

Locks in Moisture: Shea butter in our hair conditioner for women prevents water loss and hair breakage. It retains moisture in the hair strands, making the hair look hydrated & voluminous.

For best results, use Bodywise Deep Conditioner for Dry Hair for 3 months.

200 ml | Two months usage

Get 20% cashback in your BW Purse

Step 1: After washing your hair with Bodywise Anti Hair Fall Keratin Shampoo, gently squeeze excess water from your hair.
Step 2: Apply 2 teaspoons of our Hair Conditioner for women uniformly across hair strands and the tip of the hair.
Step 3: Leave the deep conditioner for 1-2 minutes and rinse well.

timeline.title: Hair Nourishment
timeline.description: Silk Protein acts by neutralizing the electrical negative charge of the hair fiber by adding positive charges and by lubricating the cuticle that reduces fiber hydrophilicity. This results in significant reduction in hair frizz.

timeline.title: Improvement in Hair Shine
timeline.description: Niacinamide, Shea Butter & Silk Protein enhance the shine of hair fiber by reflecting the light. Dimethicone has the effect of protecting the hair shaft from abrasive actions while siloxysilicates increase hair body.

timeline.title: Seal the cuticle
timeline.description: Polysiloxane polymers re-cement lifted cuticle scales and prevent damage from heat. Dimethicones are hydrophobic, so they adsorb better on virgin hair and root rather than tips. To enhance the deposition of dimethicone on chemical treated and damaged hair the products use cationic bridging agents which act increasing affinity between hair and the silicone.

faqs.question: How does this Hair Conditioner for women hydrate my hair?
faqs.answer: This conditioner includes silk protein, biotin and shea butter which work to hydrate the hair, whilst the clever formulas actually penetrates the hair cuticle, targeting your most damaged strands, and hydrates from deep within the hair structure – instead of just coating the surface! This delivers long-lasting moisture and improves the condition and appearance of dry, damaged hair.

faqs.answer: Our conditioner is made with clinically proven safe & effective ingredients. It is free of harmful chemicals such as paraben and SLS
